label: No placebo
rationale: This is a single-group behavioral/supportive-care study with one experimental arm of psychological assessments. The record describes observations and questionnaires during a multidisciplinary assessment, with no control arm, sham, or placebo comparator described.

evidence.quote: The various scales and self-questionnaires can be completed during this time.
The evaluation of the patients' feeling of being a burden has rarely been addressed in previous studies in ALS on the notion of burden.

title: Anticipated Patient and Caregiver Burden

rule.label: No placebo
rule.reason: All recorded arms have recognized non-placebo types and no placebo mention in arms/interventions. Inferred from saved data; sham controls count as no placebo.
